title: Four Ways to Find an English Speaking Partner

source.name: VOA Learning English — Four Ways to Find an English Speaking Partner
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: Many VOA Learning English users live in places where it is hard to find someone to practice speaking English with. You may be one of those people. So you may have tried to find people online, even on our website or social media pages. And maybe you found a partner or maybe you did not.
If you have been unlucky in finding a partner, today’s Education Tips is for you. On this program, we offer four tips to help you find someone who wants to practice speaking English with you.
Facebook groups are excellent for finding people who share your interests, including English learning.

You will want to make sure you join a group whose members are very active. When deciding on a group to join, keep in mind that groups with thousands of members may not be as active as smaller groups. So take some time to look around and then choose a group, or maybe a few.

After joining a group and spending time observing its posts, you will begin to see which members are the most active. If you notice that someone writes a lot of useful comments or questions, they are probably serious about learning English. Consider messaging them directly to ask if they would like to practice speaking English with you. You can practice through Facebook Messenger or video apps like Zoom or Skype.
Meetup is a free website that helps people with similar interests find each other and meet in person. Users of the website can be found around the world.

Members of language Meetup groups often meet in public places, such as coffee houses. The coronavirus pandemic has led some groups to meet online, or in places where safe social distancing is possible.
Language exchanges are unlike usual speaking practices. In a language exchange, a meeting is divided into practicing two languages.

Suppose for example you are a native Portuguese speaker and you want to practice English. Your partner is a native English speaker who wants to practice Portuguese. You and your partner would speak English for one half of the meetings and Portuguese for the other half.
Our final tip for today is to “cast a wide net.” That means to try many different things to increase your chances of getting what you want.

Tell your friends, family and coworkers that you are serious about improving your English. Maybe explain your reasons for learning the language. Let them know you are looking for an English speaker to talk to. Ask around your larger community as well. The more people you ask, the more likely and quickly you will find a good practice partner. He or she may not live in your city – or even your country – but you can meet each other online.

questions.q: According to the text, how can you tell that a Facebook member is serious about learning English?
options: They belong to a very large group
They have joined many groups at once
They often write helpful comments or questions
They always reply to messages immediately
questions.explain: Đoạn 5: nếu ai đó thường viết nhiều bình luận/câu hỏi hữu ích thì “they are probably serious about learning English”.

questions.q: Why does the writer warn about joining a group with thousands of members?
options: A very big group may be less lively than a small one
Large groups are only for advanced learners
Large groups usually charge a fee
Large groups never allow private messages
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: nhóm hàng nghìn thành viên “may not be as active as smaller groups”.

questions.q: What is special about a language exchange?
options: It is only open to people who live in the same city as each other
It is held in a language school where a qualified teacher leads the class
It is a recorded course in which there is no real partner to talk to
The time is shared between two languages so each person helps the other
questions.explain: Đoạn 8–9: buổi gặp được chia để luyện hai ngôn ngữ; mỗi người nói tiếng của mình một nửa thời gian.

questions.q: Why does the writer encourage you to tell friends, family and coworkers that you want a partner?
options: They can write a letter of recommendation to a language school
More people knowing means a partner may be found sooner
Those people will certainly be good partners themselves
It is a cheap way of paying for private English lessons
questions.explain: Đoạn 11: “The more people you ask, the more likely and quickly you will find a good practice partner.”

questions.q: How has the coronavirus pandemic changed some Meetup groups?
options: They only meet in coffee houses and no longer use the internet
Some now meet over the internet instead, or where members can keep their distance
They have stopped meeting altogether and have closed their pages
They now charge a fee for every meeting that members attend
questions.explain: Đoạn 7: một số nhóm gặp trực tuyến hoặc ở nơi có thể giữ khoảng cách an toàn.

questions.q: Meetup is a website that members must pay to use.
Most people who find a partner online meet that person face to face within a year.
questions.explain: Bài không đưa ra thông tin hay số liệu nào về việc gặp mặt trực tiếp sau khi tìm được bạn luyện nói online.
